intent: FOH owner foh-hev-kit-20261029; reply macbook/foh-hev. Live defect after kit main 0a6682b (chunk index) rollout, summary repair pass 2 on 2026-10-30: Codex coverage is 73 summarized vs 995 blank in the 30-day window (Claude Code 1883 vs 82). Blank reason: 'Configured summarizer returned no task or invalid output'. Cause, verified on live hev-traces: Codex archives AGENTS.md as the first user message, stored as several chunks of one block (same seq, part 0..N, each <=1200 chars); only part 0 carries the '# AGENTS.md instructions' / '<INSTRUCTIONS>' opener, and an <environment_context> block shares the same seq as another part-0 chunk. cmd/hev/backfill_summary.go summaryChunkSource applies trace.RequestText chunk by chunk, so continuation chunks (e.g. 'ons or changes to permissions, credentials\n  or agent config...') pass as requests and the summarizer is fed an AGENTS.md fragment. The real request is a later seq (e.g. seq 1 'You are a background coding session started by hev factory...'). Also SummaryUserChunks ranks by seq only, so parts within a seq arrive unordered, and it does not request the part attribute (BlockRow has no Part). Fix: read part in SummaryUserChunks (add Part to the row type used there; part is already indexed), group chunks per session by seq, reassemble each message in part order, then apply RequestText to the whole reassembled message; a message whose reassembled text is injected-only contributes nothing. Handle multiple blocks sharing one seq (e.g. environment_context part 0 plus AGENTS.md parts 0..N) so injected context is still recognised regardless of arrival order (e.g. treat each part-0 chunk as a block start and attach later parts to the block whose opener is injected, or any equivalent rule that is correct for this layout). Keep the 1000-char cap and first-request preference. Do not loosen the summary guard. Add table tests built from the observed layout (shuffled parts, two part-0 chunks in seq 0, AGENTS.md split mid-sentence, real request at seq 1 split over parts) asserting the source starts with the seq-1 request, plus a test that a session with only injected messages and a smoke prompt 'Reply with only the word ok.' still yields that prompt (guard decides). Work only in this kit clone, commit your candidate. Do not push, merge, deploy, write to any live namespace, resolve credentials, spawn workers or accept your own work. Report: what changed, tests and output, candidate commit.
